cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Ayekoo pairs a small quantized language model with a curated corpus of Ghanaian agricultural knowledge — crop calendars for local staples, pest and disease entries under the names farmers actually use, input costs in GHS, and the season structure including harmattan and the coastal/northern split. The model answers from retrieved corpus passages rather than from its own parameters. Remove the corpus and the system stops being useful, which is the test of load-bearing: the agricultural knowledge is the substance of every answer, not a wrapper around a general-purpose chatbot.
